2. Scope
This policy applies to employees, contractors, interns and authorised third parties who access
Corporate IT systems managed by Asteron Systems Pvt. Ltd., including the corporate identity
platform, email, collaboration tools, source-code repositories, endpoint management systems and
internal business applications, at the Bengaluru and Mumbai offices and for remote users connecting
through the company-managed VPN.
Scope note: this version does not expressly identify or include a Cardholder Data Environment (CDE)
or payment-processing infrastructure.

6. Authentication and Password Requirements
Minimum password length: 8 characters. Passwords must contain characters from at least three of
the following groups: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers and special characters.

7. Multi-Factor Authentication
Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory for remote access through the corporate VPN and
for administrative access to cloud management consoles where the platform supports MFA. Standard
internal user access to applications from the managed corporate network may use single-factor
authentication where integrated with the corporate identity provider and no elevated privileges are
granted. Current MFA requirement is therefore not universal across all access paths.

9. Access Reviews
System Owners shall review user access at least quarterly for critical systems and at least annually
for other in-scope Corporate IT systems.
